article.title: ‘I think AIPAC is finished’: An interview with Mondoweiss founder Phil Weiss
article.author: Michael Arria
article.content: Mondoweiss founder Phil Weiss reflects on the early days of Mondoweiss, the challenges of covering the Israel Lobby, and the major shifts happening with the US-Israel relationship.
